description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for an OTP (One-Time Password) verification screen. It mimics an Android activity for OTP input and includes UI components such as a header, input field, verification button, and testing/debugging features like OTP bypass.

classes.name: OTPSecondScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the OTP verification screen, accepting a mobile number as input.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the OTPSecondScreen widget.

methods.name: _OTPSecondScreenState
methods.description: State class managing the OTP input, verification logic, and UI interactions.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the OTP controller when the widget is removed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree consisting of the OTP input UI.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap events on the Continue button, including triple-tap detection to trigger OTP bypass in testing mode.

methods.name: _bypassOTPForTesting
methods.description: Bypasses OTP verification for testing purposes, updates preferences, shows a snackbar, and navigates to the home activity.

methods.name: _verifyOTP
methods.description: Simulates OTP verification, updates preferences, and navigates to the home activity.
